info.title: QualityGuard.Mcp
info.description: Model Context Protocol server for QualityGuard: exposes code scans, Quality Gate evaluation and AI-oriented Markdown reports as MCP tools over stdio or HTTP.

options.name: --transport
options.description: stdio (default, for local clients) or http (remote / Streamable HTTP).

options.name: --host
options.description: bind address for the HTTP transport (default localhost).

options.name: --port
options.description: TCP port for the HTTP transport (default 3001).

options.name: --endpoint
options.description:
HTTP route of the MCP endpoint (default /mcp).
Environment variables: QG_MCP_TRANSPORT, QG_MCP_HOST, QG_MCP_PORT, QG_MCP_ENDPOINT.
